headline: MIL @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.56 at CHC 3.81, with a projected total of 8.37. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (MIL +0.25, CHC +0.10), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.35, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Ben Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, William Contreras, Michael Busch, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt Shaw, Ian Happ because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
